name: Post-Login Browser Automation
description: Scoped authorized post-login browser automation playbook: operator approves the authenticated-session action list in the scope manifest `post_login_automation` block, then FORGE replays captured session cookies through a Playwright browser to perform the pre-authorized, bounded, read-only steps against the target web app. All navigation, screenshots, and extracted data references are stored as audit evidence encrypted under FORGE_ENGAGEMENT_KEY. The playbook refuses to run unless the current engagement scope manifest declares the exact navigation targets and ROE reference.
